title: A Hand That Pinches: Stroke, Force, Friction, and How Heavy a Thing Two Fingers Can Hold

artifact.note: a parallel gripper as numbers: a stroke (how far the fingers open), a force range, a finger speed and a friction coefficient between pad and thing; the force that two fingers need to hold a mass that is being accelerated, the heaviest thing a given force holds, whether a width fits between the fingers, how long closing takes, and the margin a chosen force leaves over what is needed
